fields.risk: The base notion (jet transport for a method, single global Weil algebra) is not yet formalized in this thread, and the posed 'per-coordinate' generalization was picked from a longer uncommitted list (parameters/time/initial-value/nested/same-dimension) without argued priority. It plausibly conflicts with the coordinate-invariance that seems load-bearing for what 'jet transport' / 'a large class of vector fields' are meant to capture (k-jets and Weil functors are classically natural/coordinate-free); a per-coordinate fibered lift depends on a distinguished coordinate system. Left unflagged, the eventual result risks being either near-trivial (a tensor-product-of-Weil-algebras normal-form fact) or a silently narrower, chart-fixed question than the coordinate-free classification the program intends.
